title: Algebra 1: From Expressions to Quadratics and Data
audience: teenagers aged 14 to 16 who have finished 8th-grade math
length_note: The course has 51 classes, about 28 hours in total. Each class teaches one main idea, so no one has to hold several new things in mind at once. Nothing in your list is skipped. The classes are grouped as expressions (3), equations and inequalities (6), functions (3), linear functions and models (9), systems (5), exponents and exponential models (6), polynomials and factoring (7), quadratics (6), function comparison (1), statistics (4) and a capstone (1). Most classes run 30 minutes, which matches the half-hour request. Thirteen run 40 minutes and the capstone runs 45. Those are topics with several steps or a modeling task, such as multi-step equations, factoring with a leading coefficient, completing the square, the quadratic formula and the statistics classes. Cutting them to 30 minutes would mean rushing. Each class builds on the one before it. Equations come before functions, and lines come before systems. Exponents come before polynomials, and factoring comes before quadratics. Statistics comes last because it uses lines, functions and models from earlier. Every class uses a real-world setting such as games, money or sports. The needs_research flag marks classes whose examples depend on real facts, rates or data sets that must be sourced before the lesson is written.

classes.title: Variables and Expressions
classes.goal: Say what a variable is and turn a short real-life situation into an expression, and the reverse.
topics: variables as unknown or changing amounts

classes.title: Order of Operations and Evaluating Expressions
classes.goal: Evaluate an expression correctly by substituting values and following the order of operations.

classes.title: Properties and Simplifying Expressions
classes.goal: Simplify an expression using the distributive property and by combining like terms.

classes.title: One-Step and Two-Step Equations
classes.goal: Solve one- and two-step equations with inverse operations and check the answer.

classes.title: Multi-Step Equations and Variables on Both Sides
classes.goal: Solve equations that need distributing, combining like terms or moving variables across the equals sign, and recognize equations with no solution or infinitely many.
topics: comparing two phone or gym plans

classes.title: Formulas and Literal Equations
classes.goal: Rearrange a formula to solve for a chosen variable.

classes.title: Ratios, Rates, Proportions and Percent
classes.goal: Use ratios, unit rates and percent equations to solve problems about prices, discounts, tips and sports averages.

classes.title: Solving and Graphing Inequalities
classes.goal: Solve a one-variable inequality, graph it on a number line, and explain what the solutions mean.
topics: solving with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division

classes.title: Compound Inequalities and Absolute Value
classes.goal: Solve and graph 'and'/'or' inequalities and solve basic absolute value equations and inequalities.

classes.title: Relations and Functions
classes.goal: Decide whether a relation is a function and explain why, using tables, mappings and the vertical line test.

classes.title: Function Notation
classes.goal: Read and use f(x) notation to evaluate functions and interpret the results.
topics: finding x for a given f(x)

classes.title: Graphs of Functions: Domain, Range and Behavior
classes.goal: Read a graph to find domain, range, intercepts, and where a function increases or decreases.

classes.title: Slope and Rate of Change
classes.goal: Find slope from a graph, a table or two points and explain it as a rate of change.

classes.title: Slope-Intercept Form and Graphing Lines
classes.goal: Graph a line from y = mx + b and explain what m and b mean in a situation.

classes.title: Point-Slope and Standard Form
classes.goal: Write a line in point-slope and standard form and convert between forms.

classes.title: Writing Linear Equations from Information
classes.goal: Write a linear equation from a graph, a table, a point and slope, or two points.

classes.title: Parallel and Perpendicular Lines
classes.goal: Write the equation of a line parallel or perpendicular to a given line through a given point.

classes.title: Linear Inequalities in Two Variables
classes.goal: Graph a linear inequality and test points to decide which side to shade.
topics: constraints such as time and money limits

classes.title: Arithmetic Sequences as Linear Functions
classes.goal: Write a rule for an arithmetic sequence and connect it to a linear function.
topics: sequences as functions on whole numbers

classes.title: Piecewise and Absolute Value Functions, and Transformations
classes.goal: Graph piecewise and absolute value functions and describe shifts, stretches and reflections of a graph.

classes.title: Building Linear Models from Data
classes.goal: Draw and use a line of best fit on a scatter plot to make and judge predictions.

classes.title: Systems of Equations by Graphing
classes.goal: Solve a system by graphing and say what the intersection point means.
topics: one, none or infinitely many solutions

classes.title: Systems by Substitution
classes.goal: Solve a system by substitution and check the answer.

classes.title: Systems by Elimination
classes.goal: Solve a system by adding or subtracting equations, including after multiplying one or both.

classes.title: Choosing a Method and Solving Systems Word Problems
classes.goal: Pick the most efficient method for a system and solve real problems with it.

classes.title: Systems of Linear Inequalities
classes.goal: Graph a system of inequalities and identify points that satisfy all the conditions.

classes.title: Exponent Rules
classes.goal: Simplify expressions using the product, quotient and power rules.
topics: power of a power and of a product

classes.title: Zero and Negative Exponents, and Scientific Notation
classes.goal: Evaluate zero and negative exponents and write and compute with numbers in scientific notation.
topics: very large and very small quantities

classes.title: Roots and Rational Exponents
classes.goal: Simplify square roots and cube roots and connect roots to fractional exponents.

classes.title: Exponential Functions: Growth and Decay
classes.goal: Recognize and graph y = a·b^x and tell growth from decay.

classes.title: Exponential Models and Compound Interest
classes.goal: Write and use an exponential model for situations such as savings, loans or spreading content, and interpret the result.
topics: modeling with a table and equation

classes.title: Geometric Sequences and Linear vs Exponential
classes.goal: Write a geometric sequence rule and decide from a table, graph or story whether growth is linear or exponential.

classes.title: Adding and Subtracting Polynomials
classes.goal: Name polynomials by degree and terms and add or subtract them.

classes.title: Multiplying Polynomials
classes.goal: Multiply monomials, binomials and larger polynomials.
topics: multiplying a binomial by a trinomial

classes.title: Special Products
classes.goal: Expand squares of binomials and the product of a sum and difference by pattern.

classes.title: Factoring Out the Greatest Common Factor and Grouping
classes.goal: Factor a polynomial by pulling out the GCF and by grouping, and check by multiplying.

classes.title: Factoring x² + bx + c
classes.goal: Factor trinomials with a leading coefficient of 1.

classes.title: Factoring ax² + bx + c
classes.goal: Factor trinomials whose leading coefficient is not 1.

classes.title: Special Factoring and a Factoring Strategy
classes.goal: Factor differences of squares and perfect square trinomials and choose the right method for any polynomial.

classes.title: Quadratic Functions and Their Graphs
classes.goal: Graph a parabola and name its vertex, axis of symmetry, intercepts and direction.

classes.title: Vertex Form and Transformations of Parabolas
classes.goal: Use vertex form to graph a parabola and describe how a, h and k change it.

classes.title: Solving Quadratics by Factoring
classes.goal: Solve quadratic equations by factoring and the zero product property and link solutions to x-intercepts.

classes.title: Square Roots and Completing the Square
classes.goal: Solve quadratics by taking square roots and by completing the square.

classes.title: The Quadratic Formula and the Discriminant
classes.goal: Solve any quadratic with the quadratic formula and use the discriminant to say how many real solutions it has.
topics: formula and where it comes from

classes.title: Quadratic Models
classes.goal: Model and solve problems about projectiles, area and profit with quadratics and interpret the vertex and intercepts.

classes.title: Comparing Linear, Exponential and Quadratic Functions
classes.goal: Choose and justify the function type that best fits a table, graph or story.
topics: constant difference vs constant ratio vs second difference

classes.title: Describing Data: Displays, Center and Spread
classes.goal: Display one-variable data and describe it with mean, median, range and shape.

classes.title: Box Plots, Standard Deviation and Outliers
classes.goal: Build and read box plots, interpret standard deviation, and compare two data sets.

classes.title: Two-Way Tables and Categorical Data
classes.goal: Read two-way frequency tables and find joint, marginal and relative frequencies.

classes.title: Correlation, Residuals and Causation
classes.goal: Judge how well a line fits data using the correlation coefficient and residuals and explain why correlation is not causation.

classes.title: Capstone: Solve a Real Problem with Algebra
classes.goal: Choose a real situation (game, money or sports), build and compare models, and explain the findings in plain words.
topics: build linear, exponential or quadratic models
